<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>THUNYAKORN PIAMANBOONTEE — 3D Portfolio</title>
<meta name="description" content="THUNYAKORN PIAMANBOONTEE — 3D Art, Product Design, Environment Design, Character Modeling and Unity projects.">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#030504; --panel:rgba(9,14,10,.78); --line:rgba(155,255,174,.18);
  --text:#ebffef; --muted:#8cae94; --green:#8dff9f; --green2:#d9ffe0;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;background:var(--bg)}
body{margin:0;background:
radial-gradient(circle at 75% 17%,rgba(55,140,72,.15),transparent 32%),
radial-gradient(circle at 10% 70%,rgba(55,140,72,.08),transparent 28%),var(--bg);
color:var(--text);font-family:"Courier New",monospace;overflow-x:hidden}
::selection{background:var(--green);color:#041007}
#scene{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0}
#scene canvas{display:block}
.scan{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:.09;
background:repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0 3px,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 4px,transparent 5px)}
.vignette{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;
background:radial-gradient(circle,transparent 38%,rgba(0,0,0,.62) 100%)}
.ui{position:relative;z-index:2}
header{min-height:100vh;padding:22px 5vw 28px;display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto}
nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px}
.logo{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--green);text-transform:uppercase}
nav a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.13em;margin-left:22px;text-transform:uppercase}
nav a:hover{color:var(--green2)}
.hero{align-self:center;max-width:1000px;pointer-events:none}
.kicker{margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--green);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase}
h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(47px,8.5vw,125px);line-height:.86;letter-spacing:-.065em;text-transform:uppercase}
.rule{height:1px;width:min(550px,58vw);background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green),transparent);margin:30px 0 18px}
.hero p{max-width:610px;margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.8}
.hero p strong{color:var(--green2)}
.meta{align-self:end;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;color:rgba(230,255,233,.48);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase}
main{padding:4vh 5vw 9vh;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,rgba(3,5,4,.97) 6%);position:relative;z-index:2}
.section{max-width:1220px;margin:0 auto;padding:9vh 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:170px 1fr;gap:30px}
.no{color:var(--green);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em}
h2{font-size:clamp(31px,5vw,62px);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:0;text-transform:uppercase}
.lead{max-width:690px;margin:28px 0 0 200px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.9}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:55px;margin-top:46px}
.about p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.9}
.facts{display:grid;gap:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.fact{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:11px}
.fact span:first-child{color:var(--muted)}
.fact span:last-child{text-align:right;color:var(--green2)}
.edu{margin-top:26px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.edu h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:13px}
.edu p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.7}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:24px}
.chip{border:1px solid rgba(141,255,159,.2);padding:8px 10px;color:var(--green2);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em}
.tools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:20px}
.tool{padding:13px;border:1px solid rgba(141,255,159,.14);background:rgba(8,15,10,.45);color:#d9ffe0;font-size:10px}
.workgrid{margin-top:45px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:16px}
.project{grid-column:span 6;border:1px solid rgba(141,255,159,.17);background:rgba(6,12,8,.68);overflow:hidden;transition:.2s}
.project:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:rgba(141,255,159,.5)}
.project img{width:100%;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;filter:saturate(.82) contrast(1.02)}
.project .copy{padding:18px 19px 20px}
.tag{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.17em;color:var(--green);text-transform:uppercase}
.project h3{font-size:22px;margin:12px 0 9px;letter-spacing:-.04em;text-transform:uppercase}
.project p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.7}
.wide{grid-column:span 8}.small{grid-column:span 4}
.gallery{margin-top:45px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}
.shot{position:relative;border:1px solid rgba(141,255,159,.12);overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;background:#071008}
.shot img{width:100%;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .25s}
.shot:hover img{transform:scale(1.035)}
.shot span{position:absolute;left:9px;bottom:8px;padding:6px 8px;background:rgba(3,5,4,.8);font-size:8px;color:var(--green2);letter-spacing:.12em}
.skills{margin-top:45px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.skill{min-height:145px;padding:20px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.skill:nth-child(4n){border-right:0}
.skill:nth-last-child(-n+4){border-bottom:0}
.skill i{font-style:normal;color:rgba(141,255,159,.55);font-size:9px}
.skill h3{font-size:14px;text-transform:uppercase;margin:29px 0 8px}
.skill p{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;line-height:1.6;margin:0}
.contact{margin-top:45px;border:1px solid rgba(141,255,159,.3);padding:28px;background:rgba(7,13,9,.65)}
.contact p{margin:0 0 16px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.8}
.mail{display:block;color:var(--green2);text-decoration:none;font-size:clamp(15px,2.5vw,28px);word-break:break-word}
.phone{color:var(--green);font-size:11px;margin-top:9px}
footer{max-width:1220px;margin:0 auto;padding-top:26px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:rgba(230,255,233,.42);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.status{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:13px;z-index:4;padding:7px 9px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:rgba(230,255,233,.5);background:rgba(2,5,3,.72);border:1px solid rgba(141,255,159,.16);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10;background:rgba(0,0,0,.85);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:25px}
.modal.show{display:flex}.modal img{max-width:min(1100px,95vw);max-height:88vh;object-fit:contain;border:1px solid rgba(141,255,159,.25)}
.modal button{position:absolute;right:23px;top:20px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--green2);font:inherit;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .head{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lead{margin-left:0}.about{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .tools{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.skills{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .skill:nth-child(4n){border-right:1px solid var(--line)}.skill:nth-child(2n){border-right:0}
  .skill:nth-last-child(-n+4){border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.skill:nth-last-child(-n+2){border-bottom:0}
  .project,.wide,.small{grid-column:span 12}.gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
@media(max-width:580px){
  header{padding:18px 20px}.logo{font-size:9px}nav div:last-child{display:none}
  h1{font-size:clamp(43px,15vw,78px)}.meta{font-size:8px}
  main{padding-left:20px;padding-right:20px}.tools,.skills,.gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .skill,.skill:nth-child(2n),.skill:nth-child(4n),.skill:nth-last-child(-n+2),.skill:nth-last-child(-n+4){
    border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)
  }.skill:last-child{border-bottom:0}
}
</style>

<section class="section" id="work">
  <div class="head"><div class="no">02 / SELECTED WORK</div><h2>Objects<br>with identity.</h2></div>

<div class="status">ASCII ENGINE // THREE.JS // ONLINE</div>
<div class="modal" id="modal"><button aria-label="Close">×</button><img id="modalImg" alt=""></div>

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from "three";
import {OrbitControls} from "three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js";
import {AsciiEffect} from "three/addons/effects/AsciiEffect.js";

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x030504);
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(42,innerWidth/innerHeight,.1,100);
camera.position.set(0,.15,5.4);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true,powerPreference:"high-performance"});
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,1.5));
renderer.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight);
renderer.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;

const ascii = new AsciiEffect(renderer," .:-=+*#%@",{invert:true,resolution:.16});
ascii.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight);
ascii.domElement.style.cssText += 'color:#8dff9f;background:#030504;font-family:"Courier New",monospace;font-weight:700;font-size:10px;line-height:10px;text-align:center;white-space:pre;touch-action:none;';
document.getElementById("scene").appendChild(ascii.domElement);

scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x55775c,1.0));
const key=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xeaffee,2.8);key.position.set(3,4,4);scene.add(key);
const rim=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x88ff9a,2);rim.position.set(-4,1,-3);scene.add(rim);

const g=new THREE.Group();scene.add(g);
const lightMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xd8ffe0,roughness:.42,metalness:.18});
const darkMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x315b39,roughness:.55,metalness:.08});
const knot=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(1.05,.28,180,32,2,3),lightMat);g.add(knot);
const ring=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.8,.022,12,180),darkMat);
ring.rotation.x=Math.PI*.42;ring.rotation.y=Math.PI*.13;g.add(ring);

const satellites=new THREE.Group();g.add(satellites);
const sg=new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(.08,1);
for(let i=0;i<30;i++){
 const a=i/30*Math.PI*2,r=1.8+Math.sin(i*2.15)*.18,y=Math.cos(i*1.6)*.8;
 const m=new THREE.Mesh(sg,i%3===0?lightMat:darkMat);
 m.position.set(Math.cos(a)*r,y,Math.sin(a)*r);
 m.scale.setScalar(.55+(i%4)*.18);satellites.add(m);
}
const grid=new THREE.GridHelper(14,38,0x294530,0x102216);grid.position.y=-2.15;scene.add(grid);

const pointer={x:0,y:0},smooth={x:0,y:0};
addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{pointer.x=e.clientX/innerWidth*2-1;pointer.y=e.clientY/innerHeight*2-1},{passive:true});

const controls=new OrbitControls(camera,ascii.domElement);
controls.enableDamping=true;controls.dampingFactor=.055;controls.enablePan=false;
controls.minDistance=3.8;controls.maxDistance=7;controls.rotateSpeed=.45;
controls.target.set(0,.05,0);

const clock=new THREE.Clock();
function animate(){
 requestAnimationFrame(animate); const t=clock.getElapsedTime();
 smooth.x+=(pointer.x-smooth.x)*.035;smooth.y+=(pointer.y-smooth.y)*.035;
 knot.rotation.x=t*.18+smooth.y*.16;knot.rotation.y=t*.24+smooth.x*.22;knot.rotation.z=Math.sin(t*.37)*.08;
 ring.rotation.z=t*.12;ring.rotation.y=Math.sin(t*.22)*.15;
 satellites.rotation.y=-t*.08;satellites.rotation.x=Math.sin(t*.17)*.1;
 g.position.x+=(smooth.x*.18-g.position.x)*.02;g.position.y=Math.sin(t*.55)*.08-smooth.y*.11;
 controls.update();ascii.render(scene,camera);
}
animate();
addEventListener("resize",()=>{
 camera.aspect=innerWidth/innerHeight;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
 renderer.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight);ascii.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight);
 ascii.domElement.style.fontSize=innerWidth<700?"7px":"10px";
 ascii.domElement.style.lineHeight=innerWidth<700?"7px":"10px";
});

const modal=document.getElementById("modal"),mi=document.getElementById("modalImg");
document.querySelectorAll(".shot img").forEach(x=>x.addEventListener("click",()=>{mi.src=x.src;mi.alt=x.alt;modal.classList.add("show")}));
modal.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target===modal||e.target.tagName==="BUTTON")modal.classList.remove("show")});
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape")modal.classList.remove("show")});
</script>
</body>
